title: AI Automation Cost in India: Complete 2026 Pricing Breakdown
excerpt: A detailed breakdown of AI automation costs in India for 2026, comparing simple workflows, LLM integrations, and full custom agentic systems.
intro: Navigating enterprise AI pricing requires understanding the delta between simple API wrappers and private multi-agent architectures. This guide breaks down exact cost benchmarks for pilot sprints, multi-agent enterprise deployments, and ongoing engineering pods in India.
metaDescription: Discover exactly how much AI automation costs in India in 2026. We break down pricing for workflows, LLM integrations, and full custom agentic systems.

faq.q: How much does AI automation cost in India?
faq.a: Costs range from ₹2,00,000 to ₹5,00,000 for simple workflows, ₹8,00,000 to ₹25,00,000 for standard LLM integrations, and ₹30,00,000+ for full custom enterprise agentic systems.

faq.q: Is AI automation worth it for small businesses in India?
faq.a: Yes, provided they focus on high-ROI bottlenecks. Small businesses should start with low-code automation platforms like n8n or Make before investing in custom agentic systems.

sections.value: One of the most common questions I receive from enterprise leaders is: "How much does AI automation cost in India?" In 2026, the market has segmented distinctly into DIY low-code platforms, mid-tier API integrations, and premium custom agentic systems.
